name: PunchEffects
src_typeComment: Static "juice" helpers built on the Tween engine — punch/shake feedback for UI or world objects. This is a generalized position/scale punch for ANY Transform; Toolkit.CameraTools.CameraShake stays the right choice specifically for camera shake (it accumulates "trauma" across overlapping hits rather than restarting from scratch, which matters for a camera taking repeated damage — not needed here).

src_members.sig: public static TweenHandle PunchScale(Transform transform, float punchAmount = 0.2f, float duration = 0.3f, EaseType ease = EaseType.OutElastic)
src_members.name: PunchScale
src_members.comment: Instantly bumps the scale up, then eases back down to the original — the classic button-press/hit- feedback "juice" effect. OutElastic gives a bouncy overshoot-and-settle by default.

src_members.sig: public static TweenHandle Shake(Transform transform, float magnitude = 0.3f, float duration = 0.3f)
src_members.name: Shake
src_members.comment: Random positional jitter that settles down toward the end of the duration — offsets localPosition on X/Y only (safe for both a 2D/UI RectTransform and a 3D object; Z is left untouched).
